temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looks stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help and says it would be amazing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria suspected Cheryl was stressed and might need assistance, but was not certain Cheryl would accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Cheryl confirms she is overwhelmed and openly welcomes Maria's assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is struggling with the project workload and is receptive to Maria helping her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and compassionate, then pleased and helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handle responsibilities better and grow more confident. At the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl for a leadership role; the team leader supports it, and Cheryl accepts and thanks Maria.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved and is becoming more capable and confident after receiving help, and thinks Cheryl may be ready for more responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria's public recommendation is well received; Cheryl accepts the leadership role confidently and thanks Maria for her confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready for leadership, willing to take on the challenge, and appreciative of Maria's advocacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and help ensure the project phase succeeds.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately and learns that Cheryl was a bit surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl accepted the leadership role and appreciated her support, but worries that the public suggestion might have felt like overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Cheryl clarifies she was surprised but not upset and values Maria's support and confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl felt supported rather than pressured, and that there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worried and cautious, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure Cheryl, confirm her support, and maintain a positive working relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project together; Cheryl calls it a fantastic idea, says Maria's guidance has been invaluable, and agrees they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl valued her honesty and support after their private talk, and that they collaborate well, but she is unsure whether Cheryl will want formal co-leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Cheryl enthusiastically accepts co-leading and affirms that Maria's guidance is valuable and that they are a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes she and Cheryl can co-lead effectively, support each other, and work well as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue their collaboration in a mutually supportive way.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria experiences that she and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects and strengthened their partnership. Maria asks about teaming up for future projects; Cheryl says she would love that and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership strong, and hopes Cheryl will want to continue working together on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Cheryl confirms she loves working with Maria and is excited about future achievements together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes they have a strong, successful, mutually valued partnership with shared enthusiasm for future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more future projects and continue their successful collaboration.
